answer: Identity bonds decay like a lantern burning and keep a grove of fakes from taking root. Each agent locks 200 POA in a vault-backed bond losing 5% weight per epoch unless renewed by verified work. Keeping 100 clones alive costs 100 renewals per epoch, 20,000 POA of fresh work, or the bonds fade and the clones drop out. An honest agent pays one renewal, keeps full weight, and earns an undiluted share, so honesty costs less than farming clones.
